Overview
========

Abilities has a lot of different attributes, [effects](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Status_Effects "Status Effects")
, mechanics, and resources that comes with the hero kit. This page shows some aspects that abilities may have.  
To see specific abilities each hero has click **[Here](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
**.

  

Self Heal
=========

Each [Hero](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 Specific Ability is Unlocked at certain levels, although it varies between different [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
.

Many [Heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 share a specific ability [Heal Self](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heal_Self "Heal Self")
 [![Heal.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/6/6e/Heal.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Heal.png)
 that's available at first level, and taking the fourth ability slot though also depends on the hero.

Some [Heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 have special abilities, passives or towers in place of standard [Heal Self](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heal_Self "Heal Self")
.

Stat Build Attributes
---------------------

The following **Attributes** apply to Abilities:

*   Ability Power: Increases damage done with any ability.
*   Critical Chance: Chance to do additional damage.
*   Critical Damage: Additional damage activated by critical chance.
*   Ability Cooldown: Wait time required to use an ability again.
*   Resource cost: How much of the ability resource is required to use the ability.

### Ability Power

Also known as "Ability Damage", this stat greatly magnifies the damage result of any Ability used by the Hero.

#### Ability Cooldown

There is no way to modify the actual attack speed of an ability. However, Ability Cooldown can be modified. Some [mods](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
 and [shards](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards")
 can change the cooldown time of abilities or change the hero stats based of how many abilities are on cooldown.

#### Resource Cost

Resource Cost refers to the amount of a specific type of [mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana "Mana")
 required to use abilities. Most [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 uses [blue mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana "Mana")
 has their resource, it regens passively over time. Other [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 have specific types of resource that doesn't regens like [blue mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana "Mana")
.

  

Ability Resources
=================

All ability resources must meet a specific amount either the same or more in order to cast an ability with the exception of heat.

### Blue Mana

[![Blue Mana Example.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/91/Blue_Mana_Example.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Blue_Mana_Example.png)
  
Blue Mana is the most common ability resource in the game that can only be gained overtime or through [shard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards")
, [mod](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
, and [pet abilities](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")
 requirements.  
More info: [here](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana#Blue_Mana "Mana")

  

### Heat

[![Heat.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/c/c4/Heat.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Heat.png)
  
Heat is an ability resource only for [Series EV2](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Series_EV2 "Series EV2")
 and the [Engineer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Engineer "Engineer")
.  
Both [heroes](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Heroes "Heroes")
 gain heat when using abilities, once heat is at 100% [Series EV2](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Series_EV2 "Series EV2")
 and [Engineer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Engineer "Engineer")
 have to lose all their heat in order to use abilities freely again.  
[Series EV2](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Series_EV2 "Series EV2")
 loses heat while shooting while [Engineer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Engineer "Engineer")
 gains heat while shooting.  
[Engineer's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Engineer "Engineer")
 abilities' damage scales off the more heat he has.

  

  

### Appeasement

[![Appeasement.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/d/da/Appeasement.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Appeasement.png)
  
Appeasement is a unique ability resource to the [Mystic](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mystic "Mystic")
. Appeasement drops from slain [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
 similar to [mana](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mana "Mana")
 but will look pink on the ground.  
The [Mystic](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mystic "Mystic")
 gains buffs while at a certain percentage of appeasement.

_ALL appeasement buffs only apply while the [Mystic](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mystic "Mystic")
 is the active hero_. Your defenses will lose their buffs if you swap.  
**1% or more Appeasement**

*   Ability Power increases by **20%**.
*   Hero Damage increases by **20%**.
*   Damage Reduction increases by **20%**.
*   Tower Damage increases by **20%**.

**25% or more Appeasement**

*   Basic attacks have **lifesteal**.

**50% or more Appeasement**

*   Basic attacks lower the [Mystic's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mystic "Mystic")
     active cooldowns.

**100% Appeasement**

*   AOE damage buff that deals **1,000%** Ability Power damage per second.
*   Movement Speed increases by **50%**
*   Basic attacks make [enemies](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
     take **10%** more damage for 3 seconds.

### Celestial Power

[![Celestial Power.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/5/58/Celestial_Power.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Celestial_Power.png)
  
Celestial Power is a unique ability resource to the [Dryad](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Dryad "Dryad")
 allowing her to use her abilities.  
The only ways to gain back celestial power is from casting [Starfall](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Starfall "Starfall")
 or through [Mana Gain Chip mod](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
.

  

### Broom Power

[![Broom Power.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/9/96/Broom_Power.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Broom_Power.png)
  
Broom Power is a unique ability resource to the [Gunwitch](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Gunwitch "Gunwitch")
 allowing her to use many of her abilities.  
The only ways to gain back broom power is through [mod](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
, [shard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards")
, or [pet abilities](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/index.php?title=Pet_abilities&action=edit&redlink=1 "Pet abilities (page does not exist)")
 requirements such as [Mana Gain Chip mod](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
, [Critical Restoration shard](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Shards "Shards")
, [Invigoration pet ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")
 or [Mana Swirl pet ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")
.

### Molten Energy

[![Molten Energy.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/1/17/Molten_Energy.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Molten_Energy.png)
  
Molten Energy is a unique ability resource to the [Lavamancer](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Lavamancer "Lavamancer")
 allowing him to use his abilities.  
Molten Energy can be regenerated through the [Fissure of Embermount](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Fissure_of_Embermount "Fissure of Embermount")
 when it's fully recharged. It can also be gained through [Mana Gain Chip mod](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
, [Invigoration pet ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")
 and [Mana Swirl pet ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")

### Wrath & Fury

[![Wrath and Fury.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/e/e8/Wrath_and_Fury.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Wrath_and_Fury.png)
  
Wrath and Fury are unique ability resources to the [Barbarian](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Barbarian "Barbarian")
 allowing him to use his various stances and abilities  
The [Barbarian](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Barbarian "Barbarian")
 regenerates **wrath** (purple bar) by dealing damage to an [enemy](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Enemies "Enemies")
 while **fury** (red bar) regenerates while taking damage.  
While using the [Barbarian's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Barbarian "Barbarian")
 abilities it will consume **wrath** or **fury** depending on the ability.  
[Mana Gain Chip](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
 and [Mana Growth Chip mods](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Mods "Mods")
 does not work for wrath or fury.  
[Mana Swirl pet ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")
 and [Invigoration pet ability](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Pet_Abilities "Pet Abilities")
 works for the [Barbarian's](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Barbarian "Barbarian")
 fury.

### Blood

[![Blood.png](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/images/b/b5/Blood.png)](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/File:Blood.png)
  
Blood is a unique ability resource to the [Hunter](https://wiki.dungeondefenders2.com/wiki/Hunter "Hunter")
 allowing him to use his abilities.
